## ✨ Added

- **The Version card shows where updates stand.** Under Settings, Info it shows KnightLoader's version, checks for a newer release and opens What's new in the app. On the desktop, Update now downloads the update with a progress bar, and once it is in place, the Restart button, which names the new version, closes KnightLoader and opens it. A container and the Flatpak link to the guide on how to update them.

## 🎨 Design

- **KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.8.2.** Settings, Info holds the same four cards in the web interface, the phone app and the extension: Version, Components, Help and About. Badges in connection rows are smaller, and the AllDebrid mark stays visible on a dark background.
- **The Components card says what each program does** in its (i). On the desktop it ends with the PommelPorter release the installer was built with.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The phone app and the extension say which store brings their updates.** The phone app names Google Play, F-Droid or GitHub Releases, depending on where it was installed from, and the extension names its browser's add-on store.
- **yt-dlp is current in the container too.** The image ships yt-dlp 2026.10.26 from yt-dlp's own releases, so it no longer waits for Alpine's package to catch up. The image and the app also check yt-dlp's signature on every release they fetch.
- **Fresh building blocks.** Deno 2.9.8. The container takes it from Deno's own releases and checks it against their checksum, since Alpine's package trails them by months.
- **Security fixes in the container image.** The build installs every Alpine update published after the base image, which brings the fixed OpenSSL and zlib. Python is gone from the image, and py3-cryptography with it.
- **The published images get OS updates every week.** Between releases, the KnightLoader and relay images tagged `latest` take Alpine's pending updates once a week and are left alone when no package has an update.
- **Dashboard labels.** Dashboards that read container labels list KnightLoader with its name, logo and description on their own. Put the address in the template's Dashboard Link field to make the entry a link.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface, the phone app and the extension. About no longer repeats the app's name.
